Prompts

```
['run the eval viewer HTTP server to browse eval results from a workspace directory', 'generate a standalone static HTML review page from eval workspace output data', "review a previous iteration's workspace with old outputs and feedback displayed alongside current runs", 'embed eval run outputs including text, images, and PDFs into a self-contained HTML page', "save and serve eval feedback via the review server's /api/feedback endpoint"]
```

```
{'run_eval_review_server': 'run the eval viewer HTTP server to browse eval results from a workspace directory', 'generate_static_review_page': 'generate a standalone static HTML review page from eval workspace output data', 'review_previous_iteration': "review a previous iteration's workspace with old outputs and feedback displayed alongside current runs", 'embed_eval_outputs_html': 'embed eval run outputs including text, images, and PDFs into a self-contained HTML page', 'save_eval_feedback': "save and serve eval feedback via the review server's /api/feedback endpoint"}
```
